description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Smaug triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Deal combat damage using Obeka, triggering its ability, causing you to get at least four extra upkeep steps.
Repeat step 1 during each extra upkeep step, creating at least four additional Treasures.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five Treasures, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

uses.name: Obeka, Splitter of Seconds
uses.cardState: without summoning sickness and with power 4 or greater
